step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram from Alef Education depicts a personalized machine learning recommendation pipeline. 120k Students send real-time traffic through ELB to an EKS Inferencing cluster for personalized recommendations, while simultaneously producing ~100M learning event data points ingested into S3. Authors publish content producing ~65k authoring events directly inserted into Redshift. S3 data is streamed and transformed into Redshift, storing over 3TB of combined data. From Redshift, data is ingested into an EKS Training cluster running Kubeflow. Model hyperparameter tuning is handled by SageMaker based on F1 score and Recall metrics. The optimized model is packaged into a Docker container and stored in ECR, which then deploys the container to the EKS Inference cluster. CloudWatch monitors both training logs and inferencing accuracy to trigger retraining alerts.
